[SWS_DM_00969] Padding in case of failed data capturing
⌈
If during data
collection due to [SWS_DM_00893] or [SWS_DM_00895] an external processor has
an error of ara::diag::DiagUdsNrcErrorDomain, the DM shall fill the missing
data with the padding value 0xFF and trigger a Log and Trace message.
⌋

[SWS_DM_00969] Padding in case of failed data capturing
⌈
If dur-
ing data collection due to [SWS_DM_01276], [SWS_DM_01277], [SWS_DM_01085],
[SWS_DM_01086] or [SWS_DM_00895] an external processor has an error of any
source, the DM shall fill the missing data with the padding value 0xFF and trigger a Log
and Trace LogError() message.
